credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management touted record Q1 FY27 bookings of $2.4B, yet Q1 FY27 CC revenue declined 0.5% sequentially.
Management claimed Q2 FY27 EBIT margin reached 18.2%, aligning with reported Sep 2026 EBIT% of 18.0%.
Despite reported PAT rising to ₹16,652 crore in FY26, operating cash flow dropped to ₹19,975 crore from ₹22,261 crore.

bull: Advanced AI revenue expanded from $155.1 million in Q4 FY26 to $219 million in Q2 FY27, up 78% YoY.
Q2 FY27 new deal bookings reached $3.3 billion, growing 27% YoY and 35% sequentially.
Balance sheet remains practically debt-free with D/E of 0.08 and 5-year cash conversion of 1.27.
bear: FY26 constant currency revenue growth of 3.9% fell short of management's 4.0% to 4.5% guidance.
Annual operating cash flow declined 10.3% YoY in Mar 2026 to ₹19,975 crore.
EBIT margin dropped to 16.5% in Mar 2026 quarter before recovering to 18.0% in Sep 2026.
watch: Achievement of narrowed FY27 constant currency growth target of 2.5% to 4.0%.
Capital deployment toward the ₹3,500 crore AI datacenter commitment.
Sustained quarterly EBIT margin within the 17.5% to 18.5% guidance band.
